start: Workout tab, member opens 'Build a plan' (profile goal Build muscle, level Beginner)

user_sees: 'Build a plan', 'Step 1 of N', Goal and Experience chips pre-picked from the profile
must_not: Empty chips with no default; another member's answers

steps.action: Tap 'Next' through Days a week (4), Split ('Best for my days'), Equipment, Time per workout
user_sees: Each step with its chips; 'Back' from step 2 on
must_not: Answers lost when going back a step

user_sees: The plan: its name, '4 days a week · <n> min · <equipment>', 'Routines' with day badges, 'Weekly sets per muscle'
must_not: A plan with 3 routines for 4 days; exercises needing equipment not picked

user_sees: Workout tab with the new folder open; the plan is now the member's plan
must_not: Two folders from a double tap; the old plan still followed

tests.checks: s1 see: 'Step 1 of 5' and no Back on step 1 (chips pre-picked from the profile not checked); s2 see/not: Back from step 2 to step 1 keeps the answers (the plan is still 'Upper / Lower - 4 days'); s3 see: the plan line; s4 see: the folder '4 routines, open, Following' on the Workout tab. 'Weekly sets per muscle' and a double tap are not checked
s3 not (data only): one routine per training day; every exercise fits the equipment

s1 see: 'Step 1 of 5' and no Back on step 1 (chips pre-picked from the profile not checked); s2 see/not: Back from step 2 to step 1 keeps the answers (the plan is still 'Upper / Lower - 4 days'); s3 see: the plan line; s4 see: the folder '4 routines, open, Following' on the Workout tab. 'Weekly sets per muscle' and a double tap are not checked
s3 not (data only): one routine per training day; every exercise fits the equipment

start: Builder, step 'Go easy on' and leave-out list

steps.action: Tap a sore area chip (e.g. knees); tap the i beside 'Go easy on'
user_sees: The chip ticked; 'We leave out moves that often bother that area.'
must_not: A move that bothers that area still in the plan

steps.action: Tap 'Choose exercises to leave out'; screen 'Leave out' — 'Tap the exercises you never want.'
user_sees: Library exercises only, each with 'Leave out'; subtitle becomes '1 exercise left out'
must_not: Own exercises offered; the tick not shown

user_sees: 'The plan picks another exercise for the same muscles.' — the left-out exercise nowhere in the plan, chip '<name> ✕' on the step
must_not: The left-out exercise in the plan; a muscle with no exercise

tests.checks: s1 see: the Knee chip is tapped (the 'We leave out moves...' line not checked); s2/s3 see: 'Leave out Goblet Squat' then 'Keep Goblet Squat' and the 'Goblet Squat x' chip. That the left-out move is absent from the plan is not checked on screen
s1 not, s3 not (data only): a sore area drops the moves that load it; a left-out exercise is absent and its slot filled

s1 see: the Knee chip is tapped (the 'We leave out moves...' line not checked); s2/s3 see: 'Leave out Goblet Squat' then 'Keep Goblet Squat' and the 'Goblet Squat x' chip. That the left-out move is absent from the plan is not checked on screen
s1 not, s3 not (data only): a sore area drops the moves that load it; a left-out exercise is absent and its slot filled

user_sees: Workout tab with the folder open; the current plan unchanged
must_not: The member's followed plan switched without picking it

user_sees: 'Could not save the plan' — 'Please try again.'; the plan still on screen
must_not: Half a folder saved; the answers cleared

steps.action: Build with bodyweight only and every sore area ticked
user_sees: A plan that still has exercises for each day, or a plain word that the answers leave too little
must_not: An empty routine saved as a plan

tests.checks: s2 see (data only): the plan says plainly what the setup cannot cover; a press is always found. The save failure ('Could not save the plan') is never tested
s2 see (data only): the plan says plainly what the setup cannot cover; a press is always found. The save failure ('Could not save the plan') is never tested

user_sees: The answers again (last step), not out of the builder
must_not: The builder closing with every answer lost

steps.action: Tap 'Change answers', change days from 4 to 3, 'Build my plan'
user_sees: A new plan for 3 days
must_not: The old 4-day plan kept

user_sees: The exercise allowed again in the next build
must_not: The list still leaving it out

tests.checks: s1 see/not (data only): Back from the finished plan returns to the last step with every answer kept
s2 see (data only): one routine per training day. A rebuild with 3 days and a left-out exercise allowed again are not checked
s1 see/not (data only): Back from the finished plan returns to the last step with every answer kept
s2 see (data only): one routine per training day. A rebuild with 3 days and a left-out exercise allowed again are not checked
